description: A pass killed between the mkdir of a folder with no model and the mode it is then given leaves it as the umask made it, 0750 under the units' 0027, its operation planned, and its event holding the mode 0755. The reprise, under the same umask, finds it made and gives it 0755 from its event, and the copy then goes on.

steps.text:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[defaults]
replicas = 2
[[disk]]
id = "t1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
[[disk]]
id = "t2"
uuid = "7a2b4c6d-8e0f-4a1b-9c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t2"
fs = "ext4"
[[disk]]
id = "t3"
uuid = "4f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"

fs = "ext4"

steps.query: SELECT kind, state FROM ops WHERE disk_id = 't3' ORDER BY id
SELECT json_extract(data, '$.disk'), json_extract(data, '$.path'), json_extract(data, '$.mode'), json_type(data, '$.uid'), json_type(data, '$.gid') FROM events WHERE kind = 'mkdir'
SELECT kind, state FROM ops WHERE disk_id = 't3' ORDER BY id
SELECT CAST(lpath AS TEXT), mode, created_by FROM entries WHERE disk_id = 't3'
